summary: KNCH (90.1 FM) is the National Public Radio station serving the Concho Valley of west-central Texas. It is licensed to San Angelo and owned by Texas Tech University, though it is operated from Texas Tech's campus in Lubbock. Despite this arrangement, the station is branded as a separate station.
one_line: KNCH is an NPR member station at 90.1 FM serving west-central Texas' Concho Valley, licensed to San Angelo and owned by Texas Tech University.
